interpretations: Return one row containing, in order, the unrounded sum of non-null `rebtotal` values and the unrounded average of non-null (`feerate` − `rebrate`) values from fee records where `rebrate` > 0.0005; return NULL for either aggregate if it has no values.
queries:
SELECT SUM(rebtotal), AVG(feerate - rebrate)
FROM fees
WHERE rebrate > 0.0005
